bio: Once known as the Hammelsche Scheune, this 17C barn converted into a pretty half-timbered building has bags of charm. This family business a stone's throw from the market square is run with great dedication, and attracts many regulars. In summer, there is a lovely terrace out front. The interior makes for a cosy setting in which to savour delicious food such as locally hunted game. The restaurant endeavours to source ingredients locally and knows its suppliers personally....
